name: unikodo
description: Unicode (math) symbol completions in Claude Code's prompt box: type \leq and take ≤.

enabledSchemes.title: Enabled schemes
enabledSchemes.description: Which naming schemes to offer, in preference order: unicode-math, greek, latex, typst, abacus, unicode, ascii.

includeAscii.title: Include ASCII
includeAscii.description: Also offer names whose value is a single ASCII character.

dedupe.title: Dedupe
dedupe.description: Collapse identical completions (same name and character) from several schemes, keeping the first by enabledSchemes order.
